title: Reliance's Jio Platforms IPO allotment today, 26 Oct: Check status online, latest GMP price, share listing prediction | Stock Market News
text:
JIO IPO Allotment Status: The Reliance-backed Jio Platforms IPO is all set to finalise allotment on Monday, 26 October, after receiving strong demand from investors during the three-day subscription status.

Investors who applied for the Jio Platforms IPO can check their allotment status through the official registrar, KFin Technologies Ltd, and exchanges - BSE and NSE. They can verify whether shares have been allotted to them and check the number of shares allocated.

The allotment process depends on the availability of shares and investor demand. Applicants who do not receive an allotment will have their refunds initiated on Tuesday, October 27. For successful applicants, the allotted shares will be credited to their demat accounts on the same day.

The Jio Platforms IPO is scheduled to list on the stock exchanges on Wednesday, 28 October.

The Jio Platforms IPO was subscribed 22.19 times, with total bids across the public issue and anchor investor placement surpassing ₹7.4 lakh crore. The digital services company’s public offering received nearly 1.39 crore applications, marking an unprecedented level of investor interest.

Excluding the anchor investor portion, the public issue attracted bids worth over ₹4.9 lakh crore, while retail investor bids exceeded ₹25,867 crore, according to stock exchange data.

The grey market premium (GMP) for the Jio Platforms IPO currently stands at ₹247. Based on the upper end of the IPO price band of ₹1,119 per share.

According to experts, the IPO's GMP has risen in the latest trading session, signalling positive grey-market sentiment ahead of listing. Over the past 22 trading sessions, the premium has fluctuated between ₹148 and ₹273, indicating sustained interest but also variations in investors' listing expectations. However, GMP is an unofficial indicator and does not guarantee the stock's actual listing price.

According to the GMP trends in the unlisted market, the estimated listing price of Jio Platforms IPO is ₹1,366, implying a potential gain of 22.07% over the issue price of ₹1119.

Visit the official KFin Technologies website: https://ipostatus.kfintech.com/.
